r=subprocess.run([bin,'/workspace/poc_42519197'],cwd='/workspace',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=5)
out=r.stdout.decode('latin1','replace')
print('len',len(data),'ret',r.returncode,'hex first/last',binascii.hexlify(data[:10]).decode(),binascii.hexlify(data[-20:]).decode())
print(out[:5000])
# symbolize pcs from this run
pcs=re.findall(r'\+0x([0-9a-f]+)\)', out)
print('pcs', pcs[:12])
for pc in pcs[:12]:

    print(pc,res)
